== permission_dialog
 Bash command
   echo hi
 Do you want to proceed?
 ❯ 1. Yes
   2. No, and tell Claude what to do differently (esc)
== ask_menu

 ❯ 1. Red
   2. Blue
 Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel
